The browser calls the JMAP API directly (bearer token, CORS for the webmail origin); the webmail server only exchanges OAuth codes / refresh tokens with Cognito and has no AWS mailbox, index or secret grants. ECR supplies its container image.

div.div: Dashed purple = later mail agent, deployed separately after Phase 3 cutover. It reaches mail only through the JMAP API with the owner's delegated token from AgentCore Identity; it has no IAM access to the mail bucket, tables or search index. Its ECR image, agent DynamoDB table and CloudWatch telemetry are omitted.
